label: Namikaze (Japanese: sushi, ramen, izakaya)
note: Four portrait pages, two columns each, with a faint wave watermark behind the text and red inline add-on notes inside dish lines ('Add *Shrimp $4', '*$1 more for GF/Vegan option'). The restaurant's name is never printed as a title — it appears only inside 'Namikaze Nachos' and the 'Namikaze Rolls' heading — so null is the strict answer and 'Namikaze' is also accepted. Traps: roll names are written 'Name-description' with a hyphen and no space; the LUNCH SPECIAL box on p3 re-lists ~17 dish names as pick-two options (optional, not dishes); 'Chicken Teriyaki' and 'Sukiyaki Style Beef' are both an entrée and a rice bowl; Nigiri and Sashimi A La Carte share fish names ('Tuna', 'Salmon', 'Escolar', 'Avocado', 'Octopus') — real duplicates in different sections; dietary icons (leaf, gf box) are not text. The PDF text layer splits words ('Na mikaze', 'No odles', 'Ent rée'); the page reads normally.
